title: Service Catalogue
markdown:
<!-- image -->

## Service Catalogue

Northwind Home Services · Internal reference · v2024.1

## About this document

This is the master list of services Northwind offers, with current pricing tiers and any constraints the dispatch and sales teams need to know. Prices in italics are 'from' estimates - actual quotes depend on site assessment. Prices in bold are fixed and can be quoted directly to customers.

## Plumbing

| Service                      | Price        | Notes                                                                |
|------------------------------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Tap washer replacement       | $120 fixed   | Single tap. Multiple taps quoted on site.                            |
| Hot water system repair      | from $180/hr | Diagnostic + parts. We service gas, electric, and heat-pump systems. |
| Hot water system replacement | from $1,800  | Includes removal of old unit. Site assessment required.              |
| Burst pipe repair            | from $220/hr | Always treated as P1 if water is actively flowing.                   |
| Blocked drain clearing       | $280 fixed   | Standard drain. Sewer mains quoted separately.                       |
| Toilet repair / replacement  | from $150    | Replacement units start at $450.                                     |
| Bathroom renovation plumbing | from $4,500  | Site visit + written quote always required.                          |

## Electrical

| Service                    | Price        | Notes                                                                 |
|----------------------------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Power point installation   | $190 fixed   | Per outlet, standard locations. Surcharge for upper floors.           |
| Light fitting installation | $150 fixed   | Customer supplies fitting. We supply standard wiring.                 |
| Switchboard upgrade        | from $2,200  | Site assessment required. Council approval may apply.                 |
| Safety switch installation | $320 fixed   | Per circuit.                                                          |
| Electrical fault diagnosis | from $180/hr | Sparking, tripping, smell of burning all P1.                          |
| EV charger installation    | from $1,400  | Single-phase. Three-phase quoted on site. Min. service age 12 months. |
| Solar panel installation   | Not offered  | We refer these to our partner SunPath Energy.                         |

## Heating, ventilation & air conditioning (HVAC)

| Service                      | Price      | Notes                                     |
|------------------------------|------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Split-system service / clean | $220 fixed | Per unit. Annual maintenance recommended. |

| Split-system installation   | from $1,600   | Includes standard install up to 5m pipe run.                  |
|-----------------------------|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| Ducted system service       | from $380     | Filter replacement included. Major repairs quoted separately. |
| Ducted system installation  | from $9,500   | Always requires site assessment. Lead time 2-4 weeks.         |
| Gas heater service          | $280 fixed    | Includes safety / carbon monoxide check.                      |
| Evaporative cooler service  | $240 fixed    | Pre-summer service recommended.                               |

## Things we do not do

These come up regularly. We don't offer them - refer or decline politely:

- Roofing, gutter cleaning, or anything requiring full roof access.
- Solar panel installation or repair (refer: SunPath Energy).
- Pool plumbing or pool equipment (refer: AquaCorp Pools).
- Appliance repair (washing machines, dishwashers, ovens) - we install but do not repair.
- Anything in commercial premises larger than 200m 2 . We are residential-only.
- Locksmithing, glazing, pest control.

## Service area

We service residential addresses within 40km of the Sydney CBD. Anything outside this radius should be flagged for human review - Sales will assess case-by-case. Customers in our service area but on a strata property should be told that body corporate approval is their responsibility, not ours.

## Payment & billing notes

- Standard terms: payment due within 14 days of invoice.
- Jobs over $2,000 require 30% deposit before work commences.
- We accept card, bank transfer, and PayID. We no longer accept cheques (since Jan 2024).
- Refunds for completed work are handled on a case-by-case basis through Customer Care.
